name: swiss-ball-hover.html
instructions:
1. Grab an exercise ball and place your forearms on the top of the ball.
2. Extend your legs so that only your toes are touching the floor.
3. Straighten your body out. Hold this position for as long as possible.
4. Repeat for desired reps.
starting_position: 1. Grab an exercise ball and place your forearms on the top of the ball. 2. Extend your legs so that only your toes are touching the floor.
